prompts.rear: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: directional transparent game scenery sprite. Input image 1 is the FRONT identity and style reference of the same squat rocky animal den. Author ONE new view of this exact den; preserve its broad low dome, thick irregular boulders, slate/indigo cool shadows, diluted warm cream highlights, proportions and watercolor brush scale. The entrance exists only on the FRONT; the back is closed solid stone. Style: loose gestural watercolor thumbnail built from about 8–12 LARGE irregular wet dabs and a SMALL number of merged pigment pools, deliberately lose tiny detail. Sparse broken ink accents for major rock divisions. Soft wet-on-wet fades, selective pooled edges, transparent fringes, opaque rock interiors. No rendered microtexture, grain, stippling, tiny cracks, many small stones, polished digital shading, pixels or voxels. Center entire subject on true transparent background with generous gutters; bottom of feet level. Neutral illumination like reference, no cast shadow, no ground rectangle, no animals, text, labels or props. Camera is a low orthographic game elevation, not overhead. Requested view: directly from BEHIND (180 degrees from the reference front). A broad closed stone dome/back wall, with absolutely NO arch, cave hole, doorway, hollow or exposed interior on this rear side. Similar overall front silhouette width and height, same roof crest and foot contact.
